source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: Vorpal Weapon, Turnabout, Graviton Lance Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 20 Range.
Grants the Turnabout trait:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.
Also grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]
